newsitem.title: USA: GalaGen reports promising trial results.
newsitem.headline: GalaGen reports promising trial results.

text.p: GalaGen Inc said Thursday that initial results showed promise for its polyclonal antibody pharmaceutical Diffistat-G.

The company said Diffistat-G, which is used to treat antibiotic-associated diarrhea, was well tolerated, caused no adverse reactions and maintained its ability to neutralize toxins following gastrointestinal passage.
GalaGen said it is preparing for a Phase Two clinical trial of Diffistat-G at the Harvard Medical School.
About 400,000 patients are afflicted with antibiotic-associated diarrhea annually, the company said.
Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 4-1/8.
